Plugin.Name: NVIDIA GPU Status
Plugin.Overview: Real-time NVIDIA GPU monitoring tile for the Unraid dashboard: utilization, temperature, fan, VRAM, ECC, PCIe link, encoder/decoder, power, clocks, and per-process VRAM usage with the owning container or VM resolved. Refresh 0.5-10s and history 1-60min switchable on the tile. Requires the nvidia-driver plugin.
Plugin.ExtraSearchTerms: gpu nvidia vram ecc pcie monitor dashboard temperature fan power
